mebolazine-dymethazine.text: Mebolazine turned up in gray-market supplements marketed to bodybuilders as an oral steroid for lean mass gains. It is a dimer of methasterone, and the muscle-building use rests on its steroid class and anecdote; no human studies exist.

mestanolone.text: Mestanolone is an old oral 17-methyl DHT steroid that bodybuilders have discussed as a strongly androgenic compound for strength and hardness. Its appearance use rests on class effects and anecdote; modern trials are absent.

stenbolone.text: Stenbolone, a DHT-derived steroid related to drostanolone, is mentioned in bodybuilding circles for lean muscle and a harder look. It is known mostly from metabolism and doping-detection studies; the physique claim is based on anecdote and class effects.

chain: Less water and fat, drier muscle look
mepitiostane-thioderon.text: Mepitiostane is an oral prodrug of epitiostanol that bodybuilders discuss as an antiestrogen for a drier, leaner contest look. It is studied only as a breast-cancer and renal-anemia drug in Japan; the physique use rests on anecdote.

epitiostanol.text: Epitiostanol is an injectable antiestrogen steroid that bodybuilders discuss for a drier, harder look and for limiting gynecomastia. It has been studied in breast cancer, while the muscle and appearance angle has no human data.

furazabol.text: Furazabol is a Japanese oral steroid close to stanozolol, discussed by bodybuilders for lean mass and strength. It is known in the West largely from doping history; its physique use rests on class effects and anecdote, with no modern trials.

oxabolone-cipionate.text: Oxabolone cipionate is an obscure injectable 19-nor steroid once sold in Europe as Steranabol, and collectors of steroid lore mention it for mass gain. Almost nothing is published; the muscle use rests on its drug class.

ethylestrenol-maxibolin.text: Ethylestrenol is an old oral 19-nor steroid that bodybuilders have used for lean, low-water mass gains. It was studied medically for wasting and anemia; no trials address appearance.

norethandrolone-nilevar.text: Norethandrolone, an early oral anabolic steroid from the 1950s, is cited in bodybuilding history as a forerunner of later steroids for mass. A 1959 weight-gain study is the main data point on muscle; appearance trials are absent.

mibolerone-cheque-drops.text: Mibolerone, a veterinary drug for dogs, circulates in bodybuilding circles as a hyper-potent oral pre-workout for strength and aggression. The claims are forum-based, and no human trials exist.

bolasterone-finaject.text: Bolasterone is a veterinary oral steroid from the Upjohn era that appears in steroid histories as a mass and strength compound. It now features mostly in anti-doping detection papers; its physique use rests on class effects.

chlorodehydromethyltestosterone-turinabo.text: Turinabol is the oral steroid of East German doping fame, favored by bodybuilders for lean, dry muscle gains. Its history and detection science are well documented; it is untested as a treatment for appearance.

clostebol-4-chlorotestosterone.text: Clostebol is a chlorinated testosterone mostly known from skin creams and doping cases, and bodybuilders have discussed it for lean mass. Appearance trials do not exist; the muscle use is based on class effects and anecdote.

danazol.text: Danazol is a prescription steroid for endometriosis and angioedema that has been mentioned in bodybuilding forums for its weak androgenic effects. It is studied for medical conditions; an appearance use is untested.

tibolone-livial.text: Tibolone is a menopause drug with weak androgenic activity, and some bodybuilding forum posters have discussed it as a mild anabolic. It is heavily trialled for menopause symptoms and bone; its use for looks is untested.

gestrinone.text: Gestrinone is an endometriosis steroid and the parent of the THG designer steroid, and has been mentioned in bodybuilding circles for its androgenic and antiestrogenic profile. Nothing has been studied for appearance.

testolactone-teslac.text: Testolactone is a discontinued steroidal aromatase inhibitor once used for breast cancer, and bodybuilders have discussed it for limiting estrogen during steroid use. It has been studied for cancer; nothing has been tested for looks.

formestane-lentaron.text: Formestane is an injectable steroidal aromatase inhibitor for breast cancer, discussed in bodybuilding circles for controlling estrogen. It is studied only for cancer; nothing has been tested for appearance.

fadrozole.text: Fadrozole is a nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor used for breast cancer in Japan and as a lab tool, and it is mentioned in bodybuilding circles as an estrogen blocker. Nothing has been tested for appearance.

vorozole.text: Vorozole is a discontinued third-generation aromatase inhibitor now used as a brain-imaging tracer, and it occasionally comes up as an estrogen blocker in physique forums. It has been studied for cancer; nothing has been tested for looks.

aminoglutethimide-cytadren.text: Aminoglutethimide is an old adrenal-steroid and aromatase blocker that bodybuilders discussed for cutting cortisol and estrogen before contests. It has been studied for Cushing's syndrome and cancer; the physique use is untested.

atd-1-4-6-androstatrienedione.text: ATD was sold in prohormone-era supplements and is discussed in muscle-building circles as a way to limit estrogen conversion. Lab data support the mechanism; no human trials address look-related claims.

chain: Less gyno risk, leaner muscle look
6-oxo-4-androstene-3-6-17-trione.text: 6-OXO is used mainly by people on steroids or prohormones who say it limits estrogen rise and speeds recovery after cycles. One uncontrolled study showed hormone shifts without body-composition change.

damiana-extract-turnera-diffusa.text: Damiana is a traditional aphrodisiac herb that some supplement users take as a natural anti-aromatase to support testosterone. A lab report found anti-aromatase constituents; human trials of the extract alone are absent.

white-button-mushroom-extract.text: White button mushroom extract is discussed as a food-derived aromatase inhibitor by users aiming for a better testosterone-to-estrogen balance. Evidence comes from lab assays, and human work is cancer-focused rather than about looks.

afimoxifene-4-hydroxytamoxifen.text: Afimoxifene is the active form of tamoxifen, studied as a breast gel in women, and some men consider it for gynecomastia and a flatter chest. Published trials for male gynecomastia are absent.

raloxifene-evista.text: Raloxifene is a prescription SERM for women's bone health that men use off-label to shrink gynecomastia. Forum posters report shrinkage and regrowth after stopping, while evidence for this use is limited.

toremifene.text: Toremifene is a tamoxifen-like SERM approved for breast cancer that men use off-label for gynecomastia and post-cycle recovery. Evidence for the appearance use is limited.

fulvestrant-faslodex.text: Fulvestrant is an injectable pure antiestrogen used for breast cancer, and it occasionally comes up in discussions of gynecomastia. No studies address appearance use.

bazedoxifene.text: Bazedoxifene is a menopause and osteoporosis SERM, used for bone protection and hot flushes. It sits among estrogen-modulating drugs that men sometimes research, though no source ties it to looks.
